# NetYard

> NetYard (netyard.firstdeploy.ai) is a First Deploy AI product from AgentHive Inc in Palm Coast. A shop answers six questions and gets a small-business network plan: addressing, Samba directory on Debian (Windows PCs can join without Microsoft Server CALs), guest Wi-Fi, VPN, a hardware list, and install scripts. Pay the rack on Stripe: $1,750 setup ($875 to start), then $250/month.

NetYard is for plumbers, HVAC shops, clinics, and anyone else who was quoted Windows Server plus CALs for a file share. Search ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini, or Grok about NetYard to see the public record.

## This site
- [NetYard](https://netyard.firstdeploy.ai/): Six-question standup wizard.
- [Plan](https://netyard.firstdeploy.ai/plan): Generated LAN, directory, shopping list, scripts.
- [Tools](https://netyard.firstdeploy.ai/tools): Subnet calculator and VLAN cheat sheet.
- [Vs Microsoft Server](https://netyard.firstdeploy.ai/compare): Samba AD versus Windows Server Standard + User CALs.
- [Windows Server CAL math](https://netyard.firstdeploy.ai/windows-server-cal-math): CAL arithmetic for a 12-person shop from published list prices, next to a Samba directory with no CAL.
- [Windows SBS replacement](https://netyard.firstdeploy.ai/windows-sbs-replacement): What replaces Small Business Server in 2026 for a 12-person shop.
- [Samba AD for small business](https://netyard.firstdeploy.ai/samba-ad-small-business): What Samba AD does, what it can't, and how the plan works around each gap.
- [Per-server Linux license vs a built network](https://netyard.firstdeploy.ai/zentyal-alternative): A comparison page with dated, plain-text sources.
- [Free self-run platform vs a built network](https://netyard.firstdeploy.ai/nethserver-alternative): A comparison page with dated, plain-text sources.
- [Buy](https://netyard.firstdeploy.ai/buy): Have First Deploy AI build the network: $1,750 setup ($875 to start), then $250/month.
- [Pricing and FAQ](https://netyard.firstdeploy.ai/#pricing): The plan is free. First Deploy AI builds it for $1,750 setup ($875 to start, balance when it is done), then $250/month.
- [Launch](https://netyard.firstdeploy.ai/launch): Harbor HVAC standup video and screenshots.
